df = spark.sql(f"""with only_asseverazioni as (
                        select *, count(1) OVER(PARTITION BY id_ente) as count_ente
                        from fat_delta.allpreseincarico
                        where presaincarico_data = '{anno_mese}')
                    SELECT 
                    CAST(id as string) as numero
                    ,last_day(CAST(CONCAT(presaincarico_data, '-01') as date)) as data
                    ,'PROD-PN' as prodotto
                    ,'{mese}/{anno}' as identificativo
                    ,CASE WHEN (FlagAsseverazione = 1) THEN
                        'AS' 
                    ELSE
                        'AC' END as tipologiaDocumento
                    ,'EUR' as divisa
                    , CASE WHEN (tipologia_notifica = 'DIGITALE') THEN
                        'PRIMO SALDO N.DIG.'
                    ELSE
                        'PRIMO SALDO N.ANL' END as codiceMateriale
                    ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ente, FlagAsseverazione ORDER BY tipologia_notifica desc) as numerolinea
                    ,CASE WHEN tipologia_notifica = 'DIGITALE' and FlagAsseverazione = 0 THEN SUM(tot_prezzo_ente/100) OVER(PARTITION BY ente, tipologia_notifica)
                    ELSE tot_prezzo_ente/100
                    END as importo
                    ,id_ente as istitutioID
                FROM fat_delta.allpreseincarico
                where presaincarico_data = '{anno_mese}'
                UNION
                SELECT
                    CAST(id as string) as numero
                    ,last_day(CAST(CONCAT(presaincarico_data, '-01') as date)) as data
                    ,'PROD-PN' as prodotto
                    ,'{mese}/{anno}' as identificativo
                    ,'AC' as tipologiaDocumento
                    ,'EUR' as divisa
                    ,'PRIMO SALDO N.DIG.' as codiceMateriale
                    ,1 as numerolinea
                    ,tot_prezzo_ente/100 as importo
                    ,id_ente as istitutioID
                    from only_asseverazioni
                    WHERE FlagAsseverazione = 1 and count_ente = 1
                Order by numero
